title: x-control
description: A security control from any publisher, with its specification, guidance, lifecycle state, and source provenance. Defined by the CSA Security Controls Catalog. See SCHEMA-STIX-OBJECT-EXTENSIONS.md for narrative definitions.

framework_namespace.description: Publisher namespace, mirroring the SecID namespace component (e.g. cloudsecurityalliance.org, iso.org, nist.gov).

framework.description: Framework name, mirroring the SecID name component (e.g. ccm, aicm, 27001, 800-53).

framework_version.description: Framework edition, mirroring the SecID @version component. Optional: some sources are unversioned.

control_identifier.description: The publisher's own identifier for the control, mirroring the SecID subpath (e.g. CEK-03, A.8.24, AC-1).

status.description: Catalog lifecycle. Orthogonal to the standard STIX revoked property, which means withdrawn as invalid. Never express retirement with revoked.

specification.description: The control requirement. Holds reproduced text and is therefore licence-constrained: populate only where the source permits reproduction. See CONVENTIONS-STIX-MODELING.md section 8.

lifecycle_relevance.description: System lifecycle phases in which the control applies. Distinct from status, which is the catalog's own lifecycle.

newSdoExtension.description: Declares the object as a new SDO defined by a CSA extension-definition. The definition object must travel with the instance in any published bundle.
